sections.title: Algorithm weakness.
sections.body: With 9 closed fills I will not claim a signal defect. What the 9 *do* support, because it holds on every row, is an accounting one: **realized R and realized dollars are decoupled, and nothing measures the ratio.** Dollar value of 1R per fill: $1.46 (SP500 0.10), $6.64 (BTC 0.01), $54.58 (XAU 0.01), $57.90 (BTC 0.02), $96.35 (XAU 0.01), $99.10 (XAU 0.01), $163.37 (XAU 0.02), $226.91 (XAU 0.02), $449.72 (XAU 0.14) — a **308x spread**. sections.title: PROPOSED FIX:
sections.body:
In `server/index.js`, the `/api/stats/by-setup` handler (`app.get` at 6998; setup accumulator 7016-7060), derive per closed trade `riskDollars = Math.abs(t.pnl / realizedR)` where `realizedRFromPrices` (7229) returns non-null and `|realizedR| >= 0.1`, and emit a top-level `riskDollarsPerR: { min, max, spreadRatio, n, unscored }` beside `calibrationBasis` (7114). Related open item: the register's "bridge risk budget disagreeing with itself 74x, unresolved since 2026-08-29" (evidence_register.js:234) — same family, and this measurement would give it a live counterpart.
